method: Visual comparison of all 50 local preview assets with their copied prompts; contact sheets plus enlarged review of defining cultural details. Original image-generation briefs and provenance retained unchanged. No new images were generated and external image-model outputs were not retested.

records.reviewed_appearance: Keep the dark hair centre-parted and gathered into a loose low braid, with a white jasmine garland following the braid and a few soft strands at the temples. Use a small bindi, delicate gold drop earrings and a restrained, closed-mouth smile.

records.required_details: Navy textured unstructured jacket, plain white crew neck, warm grey backdrop, individual beard hairs and natural facial lines.

records.reviewed_appearance: Keep long copper-red curls loose around the shoulders, visible natural freckles and a cheerful smile; let a light breeze lift only a few strands.

records.reviewed_appearance: Use short, softly tousled dark hair, lifted cheeks and a broad delighted smile with bright eyes. Keep the face uncovered and recognizably childlike.

records.reviewed_appearance: Use dense, tousled dark curls, a short moustache and light beard. Keep the lips relaxed and closed, eyes alert and thoughtful, looking away across the crossing.

records.reviewed_appearance: Keep a centre part and neat low bun, round dark-rimmed spectacles with clear lenses, a tiny bindi and small gold earrings. Use a gentle closed-mouth smile and direct, relaxed gaze.

records.reviewed_appearance: The woman wears long dark braids; the man has short natural hair. Both have soft smiles and look towards each other rather than posing towards the camera.
records.reviewed_pose_expression: Walk barefoot side by side through shallow foam, holding the nearest hands gently. Keep feet grounded in the wet sand with believable reflections and small splashes.
records.required_details: Loose off-white dress and rolled-sleeve linen shirt with light trousers, two distinct people, visible bare feet, low waves and a broad peach-to-blue dusk sky.

records.reviewed_appearance: Use side-parted silver hair brushed back with natural volume, a clean-shaven face and a quiet, composed closed-mouth expression. Preserve mature facial lines.
records.reviewed_pose_expression: Sit on the edge of the oak desk with the torso upright but relaxed, hands resting together on one knee and head turned slightly towards the camera.
records.required_details: Textured charcoal suit, white shirt, burgundy knit tie, white pocket square and wristwatch; oak desk, tall architectural window and subdued city background.

records.reviewed_appearance: Keep short silver curls soft and slightly unruly. Capture an open, spontaneous laugh with smiling eyes and visible natural laugh lines.

records.reviewed_appearance: Style the child’s dark hair into soft, voluminous tousled waves and loose curls around the ears, lifting the fringe away from the centre of the forehead. Add a clearly visible sacred forehead tilak: two slender white lines joined into a narrow U, with a fine reddish vertical line inside. Centre it between the eyebrows and the hairline. Use bright eyes looking at the camera, softly raised cheeks and a playful closed-mouth smile.
records.reviewed_pose_expression: Tilt the head gently towards one shoulder while keeping the body relaxed and upright. Hold one small wooden flute diagonally across the chest with both hands, separated along its length and fingers naturally curved. The flute is held, not played.
records.required_details: Exactly one upright peacock feather with its blue-green eye fully visible; yellow pleated dhoti, royal-blue sash with a gold woven border crossing one shoulder, gold-toned beaded necklace, small armlet, slim wrist bracelets and a decorated waist fastening. Keep the tilak, curls, smile, feather and both hands visible; do not replace the tilak with a round dot, crop the feather, add a large crown or recolour the child’s skin blue.

records.reviewed_appearance: Show four distinct faces: a grey-haired grandfather with spectacles, a grandmother with silver hair gathered back and a small bindi, a mother with dark tied-back hair, jasmine, a small bindi and gold earrings and a girl with loose dark hair. Use small natural smiles and attentive downward gazes.

records.required_details: Grandfather in cream with an indigo waistcoat, grandmother in indigo, mother in marigold yellow and girl in dark blue; separate brass diyas, a brass flower bowl and warm home details. Exactly four family members.

records.reviewed_appearance: Use short dark curls, a neat short beard and a calm, thoughtful expression with lips closed. Let the gaze travel towards the distant dunes.
records.reviewed_pose_expression: Stand beside the parked vehicle with relaxed shoulders and hands loosely at the trouser pockets; angle the torso towards the camera while turning the face slightly away.
records.required_details: Sand-coloured linen shirt with rolled sleeves, light trousers, dusty four-wheel-drive at the frame edge, layered dunes and low sunset. Preserve small creases and dust rather than a pristine fashion finish.

records.reviewed_appearance: Arrange dark centre-parted hair into a low bun edged with clustered white jasmine. Include a small dark bindi and a separate gold forehead pendant on the centre part. Use softly defined eyes and a gentle closed-mouth smile looking towards the lens.
records.reviewed_pose_expression: Sit slightly angled to the camera with shoulders relaxed and hands resting one over the other in the lap. Leave the forehead, earrings, necklace layers and both wrists unobstructed.

records.reviewed_appearance: Keep the child’s natural coily hair loose and full, with a simple leafy crown nestled above it. Use an expression of quiet wonder, lips slightly parted and eyes following the sunbeam.

records.required_details: Moss-green modest storybook dress with gathered fabric and short sleeves, real leaves in the crown, textured curls, layered ferns and a soft shaft of light. No adult makeup, glossy plastic costume or magical body distortion.

records.reviewed_appearance: Preserve the reference person’s actual hair length, part, waves, hairline, spectacles and expression. The preview shows short side-parted waves, rectangular dark frames and a mild closed-mouth smile; these are examples, not replacement identity features.
records.reviewed_pose_expression: Use a relaxed head-and-shoulders composition with the eyes at lens height and shoulders slightly angled. Preserve the original expression unless a gentle professional smile is explicitly requested.
records.required_details: Maintain clear eyes through the original spectacle lenses, natural skin lines and the original hair edges; use soft window light and a quiet light-grey background.

records.reviewed_appearance: The mother has hair in a casual messy bun, the father short tousled hair and light facial hair, the toddler short soft hair, and the older child long loose hair. Give each person a different attentive smile or absorbed expression.

records.reviewed_appearance: Keep a close-cropped natural haircut and a focused, quiet expression, with the eyes lowered towards the map. Preserve natural facial contrast in monochrome.

records.required_details: Tailored knee-length trench, dark cropped trousers and loafers, folded map, cafe chairs, textured wet pavement and soft urban depth. Map markings and shop lettering remain indistinct.

records.reviewed_appearance: Use a sleek dark hairstyle gathered into a low bun with an unobstructed hairline. Keep the expression serious and composed, chin slightly lifted and eyes directed beyond the camera.
records.reviewed_pose_expression: Stand with weight shifted to one leg, one hand at the hip and the other arm resting naturally. Angle the elbows and shoulders deliberately to complement the wall’s curve.

records.reviewed_appearance: Give the woman long loose dark waves and the man short tousled curls with light stubble. Capture shared laughter: she raises one hand near her smile while he turns towards her.

records.reviewed_appearance: Use short textured dark hair, a neatly trimmed beard and moustache, a light believable sheen of sweat and a reflective, closed-mouth expression looking towards the side window.

records.required_details: Plain charcoal training T-shirt, dark shorts, worn leather punching bag and gym equipment; retain an ordinary athletic physique and real fabric texture.

records.reviewed_appearance: Show one small cylindrical amber glass bottle with rounded shoulders, a short neck, a ribbed black screw cap and a clean rectangular cream label without lettering. Preserve the amber transparency and visible glass base.

records.reviewed_appearance: Gather the dark hair into a loose ponytail with natural face-framing wisps. Use an open, joyful smile with visible teeth and lively eyes looking towards the camera.

records.reviewed_appearance: Give the mother a loose dark bun with a few fallen strands and the father short curls and a neat beard. Both look down tenderly at the sleeping newborn with relaxed mouths and soft expressions.

records.required_details: Neutral cream cotton clothing, one newborn securely wrapped in a pale lightly patterned blanket, natural window light and a quiet bedroom. No unsupported infant head or extra hands.

records.reviewed_appearance: Use practical loose shoulder-length dark hair for the woman and short dark hair with a trimmed beard for the man. Give both relaxed smiles; one looks towards the horizon while the other glances towards the camera.

records.reviewed_appearance: Keep shoulder-length dark waves loose with natural frizz, no polished salon finish. Use a relaxed, slightly aloof expression and a soft gaze towards the camera.

records.reviewed_appearance: Brush the long silver hair loosely back from the forehead and let it fall over one shoulder. Use steady direct eye contact and a slight closed-mouth smile; retain fine lines around eyes and mouth.

records.reviewed_appearance: Preserve the uploaded person’s hairstyle, facial hair, original expression and natural asymmetry exactly. The preview’s short dark curls and light beard are examples, not features to add.
records.reviewed_pose_expression: Keep the original head angle, eye direction, pose and crop. Improve the light falling across the face without reshaping the nose, jaw, eyes or mouth.
records.required_details: Retain the existing shirt, buttons, background, meaningful facial marks, jewellery and spectacles if present; improve exposure, white balance and shadow detail only.

records.reviewed_appearance: Use short buoyant curls, a proud closed-mouth grin, slightly raised chin and lively eyes looking towards the camera. Keep the child’s natural age and proportions.
records.reviewed_pose_expression: Stand with feet comfortably apart and both hands on hips, elbows bent naturally. Let the cape lift gently to one side while the body remains still.
records.required_details: Homemade red cape tied over a plain blue T-shirt, jeans and red canvas trainers, cardboard skyline, paper clouds and sun. No branded chest emblem, exaggerated muscles or adult styling.

records.reviewed_appearance: Use a neat chin-length bob with a soft fringe, a small contented closed-mouth smile and gentle direct eye contact. Keep the face childlike and free of adult makeup.

records.reviewed_appearance: Keep a neatly wrapped navy turban with visible fabric folds and a full natural beard and moustache. Use a thoughtful closed-mouth expression looking down the mountain road.

records.reviewed_appearance: Use a straight chin-length dark bob with a soft side part and a few natural flyaways. Keep the lips gently closed and the gaze thoughtful, directed out through the window.

records.reviewed_appearance: The mother has natural dark curls gathered high, the father short wavy hair and a beard, and the children loose curls with one simple festive hair accessory. Use absorbed smiles and shared laughter.

records.reviewed_appearance: Show a single handmade rounded terracotta mug with a thick slightly uneven rim, one curved handle and a mottled cream-grey glaze fading into exposed reddish clay. Let the darker glazed interior remain visible.

records.required_details: One attached handle, open rim, uneven glaze, clay dust and wood grain. Preserve the handmade asymmetry, stable base, tactile ceramic texture and believable contact shadow.

records.reviewed_appearance: Keep shoulder-length dark curls full and loosely shaped, small silver hoop earrings visible on both sides, and an open laugh with lifted cheeks and bright eyes.

records.required_details: Plain coral T-shirt, saturated sky-blue studio background, two small silver hoops and distinct curls; preserve natural teeth and skin texture instead of a uniform synthetic grin.

records.reviewed_appearance: Use swept-back greying hair with natural uneven strands, light stubble and deep but natural facial lines. Keep the expression serious and reflective, lips closed and gaze directed past the camera.

records.required_details: Dark textured wool coat with a raised collar, old cinema canopy and warm bulbs, cool blue street shadows and fine film grain. Keep signage blurred rather than inventing readable titles.

records.reviewed_appearance: Use short textured dark hair, a tidy light beard and moustache, and a warm understated smile. Keep the gaze towards the camera with a slight relaxed head tilt.

records.required_details: Cream knit polo, dark trousers and loafers, one tiny chocolate cake with a single plain candle on a pale-blue cylindrical pedestal; no balloons, numerals or extra cakes.

records.reviewed_appearance: Gather the dark hair into a textured pinned-up bun with loose tendrils. Include a small bindi, traditional earrings, a close-fitting necklace and stacked bangles. Use a joyful soft smile with eyes glancing down towards the moving skirt.
records.reviewed_pose_expression: Capture one controlled turn with the shoulders angled and both hands lightly lifting the skirt edges, elbows softly bent. Keep the face sharp while only the hem carries slight motion blur.
records.required_details: Turquoise chaniya choli, magenta dupatta and skirt borders, distinct mirror-work and embroidery, festive overhead strings of lights and distant dancers. Keep the bindi and jewellery visible and the skirt physically connected at the waist.

records.reviewed_appearance: Preserve the actual sitter’s grey hair arrangement, original facial expression, visible age, bindi and jewellery wherever present. The preview shows a neat bun, small bindi, modest earrings and a calm almost-smile; do not invent these when absent from the source.
records.reviewed_pose_expression: Retain the original seated pose, hands, gaze and crop, including the chair or family-studio setting if present. Restore damaged areas conservatively around facial features.
records.required_details: Original saree pattern and border, period blouse, natural grain and authentic faded tones; do not replace the face, modernize the clothing or add details unsupported by the source.

records.reviewed_appearance: Preserve the uploaded person’s original hair or twists, hairline, expression, eye direction and all facial detail. The example’s short twists and calm serious gaze describe the preview only.
records.reviewed_pose_expression: Keep the subject’s exact pose and framing from the source. Replace the background behind the existing silhouette without redrawing the person.
records.required_details: Original outfit, jewellery, meaningful marks and fine hair edges; a simple stone-grey studio wall with perspective and light direction matched to the source.

records.reviewed_appearance: Preserve the uploaded person’s hair, parting, expression, skin tone and facial identity. Do not copy the preview model’s face or change the person’s age.
records.reviewed_pose_expression: Keep the existing body pose, head angle, hands, background and crop. Fit the new clothes to the original body rather than reshaping the body to fit the clothes.
records.required_details: Tailored terracotta blazer with notched lapels and matching straight wide-leg trousers over an ivory blouse; believable seams, waistband, cloth folds and hand openings. Retain existing jewellery and other accessories.

records.required_details: White linen shirt and wide-leg trousers, flat sandals, black balcony rail, small suitcase by the open door and blue sea. Keep braids and linen movement subtle and consistent.
